provenance.paper_title: MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimodal Model for Long-Term Video Understanding

evidence.paraphrase: Sequentially encoded frame features are cached as keys and values so the current Q-Former queries can attend to visual history.
Processed query representations from previous time steps persist separately and enter later Q-Former self-attention.

evidence.paraphrase: A fixed trained Q-Former generates and appends the query-state memory as frames arrive. For MA-LMM, this specifically supports a trained but frozen update module of visual memory bank.

evidence.paraphrase: When a bank exceeds its bound, the fixed compression policy finds maximally similar adjacent entries and averages them. For MA-LMM, this specifically supports merging or deduplication of overlapping entries of visual memory bank.

derived.hybrid_relation: The dual bank jointly activates modality-native frame features and persistent learned query states in the Q-Former.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (visual memory bank) changes through a trained but frozen update module, merging or deduplication of overlapping entries; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
